title: Turkish-Style Kisir Salad with Grilled Foie Gras
description: A refreshing and exotic salad made with kisir, zesty vegetables, and crispy textures, topped with a rich grilled foie gras.
instructions: 1. Grill the foie gras to an internal temperature of 130°F (54°C) for medium-rare.
2. In a large bowl, mix together the kisir, crumbled Turkish bread, diced red onion, sliced zesty cucumber, and halved cherry tomatoes.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together a vinaigrette made from olive oil, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
4. Pour the vinaigrette over the kisir mixture and toss to combine.
5. Crumble the feta cheese over the top of the salad.
6. Slice the grilled foie gras into thin medallions and place on top of the salad.
